title: SQD-Enabled Circuit Compression for Resource-Efficient Quantum Chemistry
summary: Sample-based Quantum Diagonalization (SQD) recovers ground-state energies by classically diagonalizing a Hamiltonian in the subspace spanned by quantum samples, requiring only bitstrings with sufficient ground-state overlap rather than an accurate variational energy. We reveal and exploit this underexplored robustness property: how much non-Clifford and variational expressivity can be removed from the sampling circuit before SQD accuracy degrades?
